resourceId.description: Opaque logical resource identifier; not a catalog reference.

nodePath.description: Stable definition-local node IDs traversed from inside an instance root. A direct child uses one ID, nested definitions add each local instance/node ID, and the definition root itself uses its rootNodeId.

componentPlacement.description: Portable placement. Insets are non-negative distances inward from aligned edges; centered axes require none.

componentSizing.description: Constrained inline sizing. minWidth and maxWidth use ordered tokens xs < sm < md < lg < xl. Parent layout semantics are validated with the component graph.

definitionComponentConfig.description: Definition-local component config. Button config excludes screen-only eventId.
